Hotel Management & Development Company | Hotel Equities

# Hotel Equities is a Premier Hotel Management & Development Partner Excellence in Hospitality

Hotel Equities operates where hospitality meets performance. Across the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America, we develop and manage branded hotels, independent properties, resorts, and outdoor destinations — each shaped by our commitment to service, people, and results.

Our specialized verticals — Full Service, Focused Service, and Springboard Hospitality, our Lifestyle Division — allow us to serve every segment of the market with depth and focus. Through HE Labs™, our innovation and incubation division, and world-class management training programs, we continue to push hospitality forward. Our partners — brand representatives, institutional investors, high-net-worth individuals, and fellow hoteliers — choose us because excellence, at Hotel Equities, is simply how we operate.

## Why We Are Different

At Hotel Equities, we have redefined business culture and captured it in our core values. From our Atlanta-based headquarters throughout all our hotels, these values aren’t posted on a wall and ignored. They define who we are and how we conduct ourselves with investors, guests, and one another.

Meet Our Hospitality Leadership Team | Hotel Equities

# Meet The Team

Get to know the dedicated professionals who drive our culture, performance, and commitment to delivering excellence in hospitality. Led by Chief Executive Officer Ben Rafter, a technology entrepreneur with extensive experience scaling hotel platforms, the company manages a diverse portfolio with three specialized verticals: Full Service, Focused Service, and Springboard Hospitality, the Lifestyle Division.

# Executive Team

Benjamin Rafter

Chief Executive Officer 

Benjamin Rafter

Chief Executive Officer

Ben Rafter is the Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities, a leading hospitality management and development firm with a portfolio of hotels, resorts, and outdoor hospitality destinations spanning the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America. A recognized innovator at the intersection of hospitality and technology, Rafter assumed leadership of the combined Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality organization in May 2025, bringing with him a track record of building tech-forward operating platforms, including Hospitality Intelligence (H.I.) and HE Labs, that drive measurable performance for owners. Earlier in his career, he led Aqua Hospitality to become the largest hotel operator in Hawaii and co-founded Innerlinx (LiveBid), which was acquired by Amazon.com. He serves on the Board of Directors of the American Hotel & Lodging Association (AHLA).

Albert Smith

Chief Operating Officer 

Albert Smith

Chief Operating Officer

Al Smith serves as Chief Operating Officer for Hotel Equities, leading enterprise-wide performance across HE’s growing portfolio of hotels, resorts and outdoor hospitality destinations throughout the US, Canada, the Caribbean and Latin America.

Al most recently served as Senior Vice President, Lifestyle Hotels, with Highgate Hotels. Prior to that role, he served as Senior Vice President at Pivot Hotels & Resorts for Davidson Hospitality where he created and successfully grew their lifestyle division to a hotel portfolio of twenty-five during his five-year tenure. A 20-year luxury hospitality veteran, Al has held key leadership roles in ground-breaking hospitality companies including Viceroy Hotel Group, SBE, and Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants.

Greg O'Stean

Chief Development Officer 

Greg O'Stean

Chief Development Officer

Greg O’Stean serves as Chief Development Officer for Hotel Equities, an Atlanta-based, full-scale hotel ownership, management and development firm.

O’Stean brings more than three decades of hospitality development, investment, and strategy experience to the role, having held executive leadership positions with top hotel brands and investment firms. He most recently served as CEO of United Hospitality Management where he oversaw a global portfolio of hotels across Europe and the Middle East.

Eric McCarthy-Zink, CPA

Chief Financial Officer 

Chief Financial Officer

Eric serves as Chief Financial Officer for Hotel Equities and brings over two decades of experience in both hotel and corporate roles and has worked for premier hospitality companies including: The Hotel Group, Starwood Hotels & Resorts, Wyndham Worldwide and Walt Disney World Resorts. 

Eric enjoys spending time with his children in their family vegetable garden. He is also passionate about supporting children in the foster care system.

Aik Hong Tan

Chief Investment Officer 

Aik Hong Tan

Chief Investment Officer

Tan serves as the Chief Investment Officer for Hotel Equities where he leads the company's investment strategies, capitalizing on new opportunities to enhance the portfolio and deliver sustained value to stakeholders. Tan is also a founding Principal for Greenwood Hospitality, an award-winning hotel operator and affiliate of Hotel Equities, where he actively shapes the company’s growth by steering its financial and investment strategies.

Sean Williams

Co-Chief Investment Officer 

Juan Corvinos Solans

President, Caribbean & Latin America 

Rob Robinson

President, Springboard Hospitality 

Rob Robinson

President, Springboard Hospitality

Currently Rob sits on the Executive Board of Directors of the Waikiki Improvement Association, holds a board position with the Hawaii Lodging and Tourism Association, and is a founding board member of the Waikiki Beach Special Improvement District Association where he currently serves as Chairman. Previously Rob was on the board of the Waikiki Business Improvement District Association, and the executive board of the Union Square Business Improvement District Association in SF where he served as Chairman of its marketing committee. Rob is also on the Advisory Board for Kapiolani Community College’s Hospitality program (HOST).

Before entering the hotel business, Rob was a successful restaurateur owning and operating restaurants and bars in the San Francisco Bay Area. From there he spent 5 years with Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, and then 10 years in multiple leadership roles with Highgate, a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company.

David Rosenberg

President, Focused Service 

Peter Tziahanas

President, Full Service 

Peter joined Hotel Equities with over 25 years of progressive hotel operations and corporate leadership experience. In his role, Peter serves as President of Hotel Equities' Full-Service division, with responsibility for overseeing key Full-Service and owned assets throughout the firm's portfolio. Peter works closely with our internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence and profitability while enhancing guest and employee engagement.

Lisa Tully-Lavian

EVP of Marketing 

EVP of Marketing

Lisa Tully-Lavian serves as Executive Vice President of Marketing at Hotel Equities, where she leads all facets of integrated marketing across the organization’s expansive hotel portfolio as well as shaping strategic corporate marketing initiatives. With deep expertise in brand development, digital strategy, customer experience, and hospitality marketing, Lisa plays a pivotal role in driving innovation, elevating guest engagement, and aligning marketing efforts to deliver measurable impact and strategic growth.

Toi Brown

SVP of Human Resources 

SVP of Human Resources

Toi Brown joined Hotel Equities from Jackson Pierce Public Affairs where she spent the last 11 years leading a diverse Human Resources team. Prior to Jackson Pierce, she served as the Training and Development Manager for Jamestown Properties. Toi is a graduate of Clark Atlanta University where she received a Bachelor of Arts in Communications and she is a current member of both SHRM and ATD.

Dan Block

SVP of Operations, Full Service 

SVP of Operations, Full Service

Brian Jenkins

Head of HE Labs | EVP of Strategy 

Head of HE Labs | EVP of Strategy

Brian Jenkins is Head of HE Labs and EVP of Strategy at Hotel Equities, where he leads the company’s innovation and incubation platform focused on evaluating emerging technologies, developing AI-driven workflows, and advancing new operating models that improve hotel performance. He is responsible for building a more disciplined, performance-oriented approach to innovation across the organization — ensuring initiatives are evaluated rigorously, tested in real operating environments, and aligned with measurable business outcomes.

Prior to joining the hospitality industry, Jenkins was a strategy consultant at Capco in New York, where he advised leading financial institutions IT strategy, organizational restructuring, change management, and risk management.

Carol Lobaito

SVP of Sales, Focused Service 

Lindsay Meadows

SVP of Accounting & Procurement 

Lindsay Meadows

SVP of Accounting & Procurement

Brad Read

SVP of Finance 

SVP of Finance

With over 20 years of exceptional leadership in strategic finance and commercial operations, Brad has built an impressive career optimizing revenue, driving commercial growth, and delivering profitability through innovative financial strategies. His expertise spans key areas such as budgeting and forecasting, financial analysis, revenue optimization, and market strategy, both domestically and internationally.

Bill Stachler

SVP of Revenue Optimization 

SVP of Revenue Optimization

Martin Stitt

SVP of Operations, Canada 

SVP of Operations, Canada

Team Member Since: 2021

Martin oversees operations for HE’s portfolio of hotels in Canada, provides support to the firm’s regional directors in-market and serves as a valuable resource for our hotel owners. He leads the Canadian regional team based in Edmonton, Alberta which provides corporate support in all areas including operations, food and beverage, sales and marketing, revenue generation, accounting and human resources for the firm’s managed hotels in market. 

Martin brings 30+ years of industry experience and a track record of success to his role with HE, as well as broad experience in all market segments from select service and extended stay, to resort, full-service and luxury. Prior to joining HE, he served as Area VP, Canada with Marriott International from 2015 to 2020 where he successfully led the integration of Delta Hotels and Starwood Hotels for Western Canada growing the portfolio from 5 to 26 managed properties with over 5,000 Associates and $600 million in annual sales.

Martin received his MBA and Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Guelph. In 2014, he received the University of Guelph George D. Bedell Alumni Award for Industry and Community Leadership. He continues to contribute to the development of leaders as Chair of the Policy Advisory Board for the School of Hospitality, Food, and Tourism Management. In addition, he provides Customer Experience advisory services to the Southern Alberta Institute of Technology. Martin has actively served in the community participating on numerous boards in Canada including the Hotel Association of Canada, the Vancouver Hotel Association, the BC Children’s Hospital Foundation, Tourism Calgary, and the Greater Toronto Hotel Association.

Fred "Coach" Cerrone serves as Founder and Co-Chairman of Hotel Equities. His hospitality career spans a five-decade progression from desk clerk at the Sheraton Boston hotel, to managing hotels across the country and ultimately launching Hotel Equities in 1989.

He is married to Christine, his high school sweetheart, and resides in Dunwoody, Georgia.

Hotel Operator Careers | Hotel Equities

# Grow Your Career at Hotel Equities

Join an organization committed to your professional growth and career advancement. Take the first step or the next step in your hospitality career path with Hotel Equities. Enjoy a culture focused on making a difference in people’s lives, limitless long-term career growth, competitive benefits and compensation, and access to talent and executive development programs.

Apply with confidence. Transparency matters, which is why Hotel Equities is committed to 100% wage transparency for all open positions. Explore opportunities across our diverse portfolio.
